To the mods: first, please don't take this as negative criticism. I like this subverse and what you've done with it. I'm just offering some suggestions. You can take 'em or leave 'em. Maybe others have ideas too? I'm not even sure who updates the sidebar or the stylesheet for this sub.

Suggestions:

  1. Fix the images -- I'm not sure what happened with the CSS or the images but they don't appear. When I first started browsing the site a few months ago I used to see the banner and custom flair.   6. Condense the Rules -- You link to Voat's rules and then list them too. I would just keep the link to the official Voat rules and remove the 5 items listed beneath it. Under the heading "Rules" you should just have the /v/niggers specific ones.

  7. Streamline the Subverse links -- I like how /r/conspiracy does it over on Reddit. They put them in a table, and have different topic categories. We could start with topics like: Nationalism, Immigration, Humor, and Other Hate Subs.

  8. Add new ones -- By having links to appropriate subs it will cut down on off topic posts. I set up /v/beaners to hate on Spics. We really need one for Sandniggers. I would also add /v/adolfhitler under Nationalism. I'm sure there are other subs out there too. Suggestions?

  9. Make the font a bit smaller -- Some of the headings seem like they're using 18 or 24 pt. font sizes. Can you maybe make them a bit smaller and tighten up the sidebar a bit? Keep them bold. But, set them at like 14 or 16 pt. font instead.

  10. Add a title heading for Moderators -- maybe it's an image that I can't see? On my screen (with the subverse styles turned on) I can't see anything but a list of moderators.   12. Improve top menu navigation -- the links on menu at the very top (with select lists) use a very small font. For the most part, I just browse the subverse with custom styles turned off. Using the default Voat style sheet makes navigation much easier. I'm not some user interface designer or expert on layout. I tend to like interfaces that are tight, clean, and have some blank space in them. I also tend to like simple layouts. I'd rather be able to browse from all my devices than have a bunch of fancy bells and whistles that only work on one platform. I also tend to like light colors for web sites. (just a personal preference).

Maybe we have some professional developers, graphic artists or UI designers here? I'm sure they could give you an expert opinion.
